name: Treemap
oneLiner: one glass slab stands up off a lit floor and is cut by lines of light into blocks sized by share, biggest first; each block names its part and counts its value up, then the biggest floods with the accent and lifts toward the camera while the rest dim
say: when the speaker says where the time, money or effort really goes ('almost half of it is editing'): cut in on the breakdown, the biggest block lifts on the word that names it
